about: A case switches on an enumerated string (chapter 4 § 4.5.2). The case route drafts the note by the input note_kind. Invalid: it switches on input.consult_draft.value, a markdown_block. Valid: input.note_kind.value.
sentences: Case 'route' switches on input.consult_draft.value, which is markdown_block; a case switches on an enumerated string.
